instruction: A tight cluster of three trumpet-shaped chanterelle mushrooms sharing one base, their wavy funnel caps flaring outward. Glazed in glossy pale-gold porcelain with delicate ridged gills flowing down each stem, they carry soft hand-painted apricot blushes. The smooth ceramic sheen and gentle curves give the fungi a refined, collectible figurine quality.
